svg.title: Figure 6-1. Hazards, hazardous events and safety goals (WP-C-03 §4-§6)
svg.desc: Left: the 9 hazards H-01 to H-09 of WP-C-03 §4 with the number of Cartesian HARA rows rated ASIL A or higher and the worst case. Middle: the representative hazardous events of §5 with S, E, C and ASIL. Right: safety goals SG-01 to SG-08 of §6 with ASIL; each event is connected to the goals whose Source HEs column lists it. SG-01 ASIL C ⚠ (D if AOU-01/02 fail) from HE-01.1, HE-01.2, HE-01.3, HE-01.4, HE-01.5, HE-02.3; SG-02 ASIL C from HE-02.1, HE-02.2, HE-02.4, HE-02.5, HE-02.6, HE-07.1, HE-07.2, HE-07.4; SG-03 ASIL C ⚠ (D if AOU-03/05 fail) from HE-03.1, HE-03.2, HE-03.3, HE-03.4, HE-03.5, HE-03.6, HE-03.7; SG-04 ASIL B ⚠ (C if AOU-05 fails) from HE-04.1, HE-04.2, HE-04.3, HE-04.4, HE-04.5; SG-05 ASIL B ⚠ (C if AOU-01/02/03 fail) from HE-05.1, HE-05.2, HE-05.3, HE-05.4; SG-06 ASIL C from HE-06.1, HE-06.3, HE-06.4, HE-07.3; SG-07 ASIL B from HE-08.1; SG-08 ASIL A from HE-09.1, HE-09.2. HE-06.2 is QM and has no goal.

Connections follow the Source HEs column of §6. No goal of its own: H-07 → SG-02 / SG-06. Covered by the goal of another hazard: HE-02.3 → SG-01. Rated QM, no goal: HE-06.2.
